accepted_scopes.exact_noise: Frozen rational tilted perturbations, periodic corrector proof, graph floor, cycle quotient rank and bridge endpoint identity.
accepted_scopes.smooth_statistics: Binary64 periodic moments, backward corrector, killed count lift and independent retained-sample graph floor.
accepted_scopes.held_probability_certificates: Exact rational three-hold rates; 320-bit Arb propagation, Doeblin-certified periodic initial law, finite-N moments and probability enclosures; separate from smooth protocols.
accepted_scopes.continuous_primal: Exact rational q,x and cubic p; exact closure, normalization, uniform mean inventory, counts and activity; rational Bernstein and outward Arb energy/rate/entropy/slew feasibility.
accepted_scopes.continuous_dual: Fixed-gate global baseline upper bound with periodic costate, interval coefficients, supporting entropy planes and rigorous LP dual-residual correction. Baseline has unrestricted well slew, making the upper bound conservative for the common finite-slew class.
accepted_scopes.frontier: Exact mixture with uniform p=1/5,x=3/16; convex constraints and entropy; separately certified uniform slew; same dual reused at reduced entropy budgets.
